subject.title: Slack: Include file attachment metadata in inbound message delivery to agents

question: What shared inbound attachment metadata shape should agents receive for Slack and other channel plugins?
rationale: The remaining change crosses the channel-to-agent context contract and privacy boundary, so a Slack-only field may create a competing source of truth.

options.title: Design shared metadata
options.body: Add a cross-channel attachment metadata field with stable names and privacy rules, then implement Slack as the first mapper.

options.title: Use Slack-only stopgap
options.body: Expose only Slack file metadata now, accepting a likely migration when other channels need the same shape.

options.title: Keep placeholders
options.body: Keep fileId placeholders and download-file guidance as the supported workflow and close the metadata request after maintainer confirmation.

recommendation.title: Design shared metadata
recommendation.body: Add a cross-channel attachment metadata field with stable names and privacy rules, then implement Slack as the first mapper.

likelyOwner.reason: They were pulled into the issue discussion and have recent Slack media-adjacent history near the affected path.
